categories.label: HACKATHON
categories.definition: Event-centric achievement: participation, placement, or team role in a competitive, bounded build event with a defined build window of up to seven calendar days, in which participants work toward a demonstrable software or hardware prototype, implementation, or minimum viable product.
inclusion_rules: In-person or virtual hackathons with a defined build window of up to seven calendar days
Role-based participation (developer, designer, team lead) and placement (winner, runner-up, finalist)
The deliverable at the end of the build window must be a demonstrable software or hardware prototype
exclusion_rules: Events whose defined build window exceeds seven calendar days belong to PROJECT or COMPETITION
Algorithmic contests primarily judged through scored solutions or benchmark performance belong to COMPETITION
Workshops with no competitive build/judging belong to WORKSHOP
examples: Won 1st place out of 140 teams at Smart India Hackathon 2024 (Hardware Grand Finale)
Finalist at HackXelerate 48-Hour Open Hackathon building an edge computer vision prototype

categories.label: COMPETITION
categories.definition: Event-centric achievement: participation or placement in a judged competition whose primary deliverable is a scored, ranked, or formally judged submission or result (e.g. algorithmic solutions against test cases, models on benchmarks, case briefs, debates, or design contests).
inclusion_rules: Programming, data-science, or ML challenges with scored or ranked submissions (ACM-ICPC, Kaggle)
Case competitions, debate, moot court, Model UN, or design contests adjudicated by judges
Olympiads, quiz championships, or named competitive events with formal placements
exclusion_rules: Time-boxed events (<= 7 days) whose primary deliverable is a demonstrable prototype belong to HACKATHON
Sports competitions belong to SPORTS; cultural performance contests belong to CULTURAL
examples: Clinched First Place in ACM-ICPC Asia Regional Preliminary Contest
Secured Bronze Medal in National Undergraduate Data Science Challenge

categories.label: RESEARCH_PUBLICATION
categories.definition: Authorship (first, co-, or named contributor) on a peer-reviewed paper, preprint, journal article, workshop paper, or technical report that reports original research.
inclusion_rules: Peer-reviewed conference and journal papers
Workshop papers at major venues
arXiv or similar archival preprints with student as named author
exclusion_rules: Course term papers not submitted to an academic venue belong to PROJECT
Patents belong to PATENT
examples: Published a peer-reviewed research paper in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
First author on study accepted for publication in ACM CIKM Proceedings

categories.label: PATENT
categories.definition: A granted or filed patent or utility model naming the student as inventor or co-inventor.
inclusion_rules: Granted patents (national or international)
Filed patent applications with a published application number
Utility models filed with a government patent office
exclusion_rules: Trade secrets or internal invention disclosures without a filing
Published papers describing an invention without a patent filing belong to RESEARCH_PUBLICATION
examples: Co-inventor on patent application #202411012345 filed with the Indian Patent Office
Granted utility patent from USPTO for an intelligent energy harvesting circuit

categories.label: INTERNSHIP
categories.definition: A time-bounded professional work engagement at a company, lab, research group, or non-profit — paid or unpaid — undertaken while the student is enrolled.
inclusion_rules: Industry internships at private companies or startups
Research internships at academic labs or national labs
Virtual or remote structured internships
exclusion_rules: Full-time post-graduation employment
Course-credit projects supervised only by university faculty belong to PROJECT
Certification programs belong to CERTIFICATION
examples: Completed a 10-week on-site internship as Software Engineering Intern at Siemens Technology India
Earned Outstanding Intern Performance Rating during 6-month Data Engineering internship

categories.label: CERTIFICATION
categories.definition: Completion of a credentialed training program issuing a formal certificate from a recognized provider, platform, or professional body.
inclusion_rules: Industry certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure, Red Hat, Cisco, Kubernetes)
Platform-issued course certificates with verifiable credential identifiers (Coursera, DeepLearning.AI)
Professional body credentials (PMP, PSM I)
exclusion_rules: Participation certificate from a hackathon belongs to HACKATHON
Internship completion letters belong to INTERNSHIP
Workshop attendance badges without formal proctored assessment belong to WORKSHOP
examples: Passed proctored exam for AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
Earned Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification credential

categories.label: PROJECT
categories.definition: Artifact-centric achievement: a substantive piece of implementation, investigation, or development (code, system, hardware, report, or open-source contribution) with a describable objective, non-trivial scope, and documented deliverable.
inclusion_rules: Capstone or final-year major undergraduate projects
Independently developed open-source software repositories or substantive merged pull requests
Technical hardware/software systems completed by student organizations
exclusion_rules: Event-centric achievements belong to HACKATHON, COMPETITION, or INTERNSHIP
Published papers reporting a project belong to RESEARCH_PUBLICATION; patents belong to PATENT
Routine toy tutorials without original contribution
examples: Engineered an autonomous agricultural drone survey platform as our final year capstone project
Developed and open-sourced a high-performance vector indexing microservice with 1,200+ GitHub stars

categories.label: WORKSHOP
categories.definition: Participation in a workshop, bootcamp, tutorial, or short training event (hours to a few days) focused on skills transfer rather than competition or formal credentialing.
inclusion_rules: In-person or virtual technical workshops organized by universities or industry
Short training bootcamps that do not issue a formal industry credential
Conference-colocated tutorials and hands-on masterclasses
exclusion_rules: Formally credentialed courses issuing proctored certifications belong to CERTIFICATION
Competitive build bootcamps with judged rankings belong to HACKATHON
examples: Completed 3-day practical workshop on Advanced Cyber Threat Hunting Intensive conducted by Cisco Systems
Attended 5-day hands-on training on Enterprise Microservices Architecture with Kubernetes

categories.label: CONFERENCE
categories.definition: Attendance, oral presentation, poster, demo, or named role at an academic or professional conference, without a corresponding peer-reviewed paper claimed as the achievement.
inclusion_rules: Delivered a talk, poster, or demo at an academic conference
Student volunteer or organizing-committee technical lead
Official student delegate attending on a competitive travel scholarship
exclusion_rules: A peer-reviewed archival paper at the same conference belongs to RESEARCH_PUBLICATION
Colocated hackathons belong to HACKATHON
examples: Presented an interactive research poster at IEEE International Conference on Advanced Computing
Served as Student Technical Coordinator for National Symposium on VLSI

categories.label: LEADERSHIP
categories.definition: A named leadership, officer, or coordinator role in a student organization, campus body, chapter of a professional society, or major event-organizing team.
inclusion_rules: President, secretary, treasurer, or named officer of a recognized student organization
Student chapter chair of a professional society (ACM, IEEE, GDSC)
Lead convener or chief organizer of an inter-collegiate conference or festival
exclusion_rules: Team participation without a designated leadership role
Technical contribution inside a project belongs to PROJECT
examples: Elected President of the ACM Student Chapter for the 2023-2024 academic session
Served as Lead Organizer for Annual National Collegiate Technical Fest

categories.label: SPORTS
categories.definition: Participation, representation, or placement in an organized athletic activity at university, state, national, or higher competitive levels.
inclusion_rules: Team membership at inter-college, inter-university, state, or national tournaments
Individual sports placements, medals, and rankings (badminton, athletics, chess, swimming)
Named tournament MVP or squad captain
exclusion_rules: Casual recreational gym activity without structured tournament participation
E-sports contests belong to COMPETITION
examples: Won Gold Medal in badminton at All-India Inter-University Tournament
Captained the university basketball team to victory in State Collegiate Championship

categories.label: CULTURAL
categories.definition: Participation, performance, or placement in a cultural, artistic, literary, musical, or theatrical activity.
inclusion_rules: Music, dance, theatre, film, fine arts, photography, or debate performances
Placement in inter-collegiate or national cultural festivals
Creative writing or poetry slam recognition
exclusion_rules: Technical festival competitions belong to HACKATHON or COMPETITION
Leadership of a cultural society belongs to LEADERSHIP
examples: Awarded First Prize in Classical Vocal Music at National Inter-University Youth Cultural Festival
Secured 2nd Position in Bharatanatyam Dance at State Collegiate Festival

categories.label: VOLUNTEERING
categories.definition: Sustained or event-based volunteering with a non-profit, NGO, civic body, or community initiative where the primary purpose is community service.
inclusion_rules: Service with an NGO, non-profit, or community civic initiative
Teaching assistant or tutoring roles done for underprivileged outreach programs
Disaster relief or public health awareness drives
exclusion_rules: Paid internships with defined deliverables belong to INTERNSHIP
Student club officer duties belong to LEADERSHIP
examples: Completed 80 verified hours of community service with Pratham Education Initiative teaching digital literacy
Recognized as Volunteer of the Quarter by Goonj for leading youth flood relief mission

categories.label: OTHER
categories.definition: Catch-all for legitimate achievements that do not fit the thirteen specific primary categories (e.g. academic convocation medals, scholastic merit scholarships, fellowships, international student exchanges, dean's honors).
inclusion_rules: Scholastic honors, university gold medals, and academic rank awards
Government or university merit scholarships and fellowships
International academic exchange residencies
exclusion_rules: Do not use OTHER to bypass resolving an ambiguous record that fits a primary category
examples: Received University Gold Medal for securing Rank 1 across all 8 semesters of B.Tech program
Conferred National Merit Scholarship for Academic Excellence by Ministry of Education
